disposition_reason: Reports mean ± SD and ranges of lead, cadmium, nickel, copper, cobalt, zinc, iron, sodium, magnesium and calcium in six biscuit types (18 retail products) bought in Lagos, Nigeria.

study.design: retail survey with chemometrics, health and ecological risk assessment
study.origin: manufactured in Lagos, Ogun and Oyo States, Nigeria, or imported from China, Denmark, Thailand and India (Table 1)
study.market: purchase points Oshodi, Isolo, Iyana-Oba, Ojo and Mushin, Lagos, Nigeria
study.method: oven drying 60 °C, wet digestion HNO3/H2O2/HClO4 (10:4:1); flame AAS (210VGP), duplicates
lod: LOD from blank SD; Cd <0.02 mg/kg; other LODs not printed
study.qa: CRM BCR-191 brown bread for Cu, Fe, Zn, Ca, Mg (Table 3); no CRM reported for Pb, Cd, Ni, Co
